title: MMA-ASIA: A MULTILINGUAL AND MULTI-MODAL ALIGNMENT FRAMEWORK FOR CULTURALLY-GROUNDED EVALUATION
findings: The paper does not provide specific findings related to religion. Religious knowledge is evaluated as a sub-component of broader cultural awareness (e.g., religious buildings, mythological figures), and results are not disaggregated by cultural theme.
